sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.22 "EXTI external interrupt selection register 1 (EXTI_EXTICR1)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1150.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bits 31:24 EXTI3[7:0]: EXTI3 GPIO port selection
These bits are written by software to select the source input for EXTI3 external interrupt.
0x00: PA3 pin
0x01: PB3 pin
0x02: PC3 pin
0x03: PD3 pin
0x04: PE3 pin
0x05: PF3 pin
0x06: PG3 pin
0x07: PH3 pin
0x08: PN3 pin
0x09: PO3 pin
0x0A: PP3 pin
0x0B: PQ3 pin
Others: reserved
l When SEC3 is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, this field can be accessed with non-secure
and secure access.
l When SEC3 is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, this field can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write is discarded. Nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIV3 is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, this field can be accessed with privileged
and unprivileged access.
l When PRIV3 is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, this field can be accessed only with
privileged access. Unprivileged write to this field is discarded, and read returns 0.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
